name: date-picker
useFor: Use DatePicker for one date (a card's expiry, a report day) and DateRangePicker for a period (spending from and to). Add presets for common choices and name to submit the ISO dates with FormData.
constraints: A free-text date without a calendar
Keeping the panel open after a single date is picked
source: Extrapolated from agentcard.com/get-started (.v7-gate-field select) and the brand's floating panel
title: Date Picker
description: A square date field with a blue calendar mark that opens the calendar in the floating panel.
